titulo: The squeak you walk past: three drops of oil
caption:
The squeak you walk past: three drops of oil

Four weeks of squeak. Cella finds the oil, puts three drops on the hinge, and the door goes quiet.

For whoever walks past it every day.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with a voice on a flat color background in an entryway. At the top, the words: 4 weeks of squeak, nobody oiled it. A small doorway-shaped figure with white eyes stands to the left of a door on the right that swings back and forth with small zigzag lines and the word eek beside the hinge. The words appear one line at a time: it squeaks. I find the oil (a gray oil can floats in from the right). Three drops (three amber drops fall onto the hinge and the zigzag lines stop). Now it is quiet (the door swings once, smoothly, and a star appears, her eyes close in a smile). The closing line: for whoever walks past it every day. Then: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: Cella oiled the hinge today. Somebody walks past it every day.
evolucion: Dos apuestas (junta-ene-s1, seccion 3). (a) El cierre con persona, sin pedido: ninguna pieza pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir (regla 8); el fijado es una frase de Cella que nombra al destinatario. Base de lectura: N2 16 % (14 de 88 Reels), 1,5 envios por 1.000 de alcance, mediana de alcance 117; con el mismo corte de la hora 168. (b) El destinatario como gancho: brazo A (abre con "For whoever ..." en el cuadro 0 y vuelve a cerrar) contra brazo B (solo cierra). Se mide a 48 h con medir.py (envios por 1.000 de alcance, vistas comprometidas) y a 7 dias con objetivos.py (N2, N4). Con 17 seguidores no separa causa de ruido: lectura de orden de magnitud. Semana sin largos ni medios (prueba 3a del acta).
